commit.message:
Integrate actual GUI color and vector storage batch156

Register the raw color setter and indexed state-vector accessor in Core, preserving the existing semantic color entry and real lower providers. Record complete Font-constructor and mapped-geometry readiness for the following work.

Final combined Win32 build passed all three existing checks in 9.09 seconds. The manifested actual-Core address-only probe passed without calling either reconstructed body. Seal and recheck 859 evidence payloads and 125 Root Source/header inputs; no Native private ABI or game-validation claim.

+# Raw GUI color and state-vector integration — packet156
+
+Two actual-storage Source entries are reviewed and registered in Core:152 AA6870 color publication and153 ACEC40 state-vector access. The prior semantic AA6870 API remains unchanged; the private raw HasGeometry projection reuses the established B74650 behavior and earns no additional Native-address credit. ACEC40 had no previous Source reconstruction row. Exact Source commits and frozen evidence are pinned in the [report](../reports/cc12_native_gui_color_vector_integration_156.json).
+
+The color setter preserves each DWORD load/store and the model capture between the first Z read/store, then both current model rereads and all genuine model/mesh/element/material getters. It rereads the original RGBA pointer for diffuse publication, preserving the supported overlaps without a snapshot, semantic-owner conversion, retain, dirty flag, FP conversion or rollback. Its explicit valid-storage domain includes the genuine NativeModelTailStorage subobject and real noexcept getter chain.
+
+The vector accessor captures begin before other raw header fields, suppresses end on null begin, computes signed wrapped byte difference divided44, and compares the DWORD index unsigned. Invalid range enters the genuine BF6713 Source gateway once; a returning handler is followed by a current-begin reload and modulo32-bit address without a recheck or payload read. New C++ value/cdecl ABI and pure-integer scheduling differ from Native stack/register/fault timing; equal strict59-byte length is not Native byte identity.
+
+Readonly151 establishes the actual Font constructor's live-argument/name/tree-cleanup composition. Root independently verified9 exact Original cleanup pairs,1299 bytes per side and25 named operand rows, including the paired one-state iterator EH maps; all29 selected call rows pass. This is readiness, not a constructor implementation in this batch. Readonly154 pins whole1465-byte ACF9B0 and550-byte ACF260, and identifies the smaller104-byte texture-normalization composition on genuine saved-dimension getters. Its11 selected direct calls pass. Neither readonly packet receives new Source-body credit. Font constructor155 and texture helper157 are independent follow-on work; whole raw Font production, FrameBox geometry/state rebuilding, clip/retained receivers and normal Text activation remain open.
+
+Compiled Source `945e81690a56bba069530670aac6dce62159abc9` passed the normal MSVC Win32 build and all3/3 existing checks in9.09s. The manifested PE32 `asInvoker` probe links both new APIs from actual final Core and returns0 without executing either reconstructed body. Root independently checked the2 whole Original spans,181 bytes/68 starts and7 direct calls, plus the already-established12-byte HasGeometry query. No new test was added. Static/build/link checks do not prove private CRT/FH3/SEH or register ABI, Original placement, caller adoption, runtime drawing or game/visual behavior.
+
+Immutable family: `local/cc12_native_gui_color_vector_integration_156/evidence_family.zip`,859 payloads and125 Root Source/header inputs. Archive SHA256 `f012dc52eea7dd0edf0faf2cb300d1fb732c0bc5e78fafa4ddcf822681ee1393`; manifest SHA256 `01e2d30c1b63136234e7348e96915f266ac02904b63b9c3dd1a9e69f403300f6`. Every archived payload hash was rechecked, including nested worker manifests. Earlier frozen families remain unchanged.

+# Raw GUI state-vector indexed access — packet153
+
+`native_gui_state_vector_record_00acec40` supplies the whole existing Native `[ACEC40,ACEC7B)`,59-byte/24-start accessor over a raw vector header. Its only observed caller is AD0D80; the2Ch elements are interpreted as FrameBox states from that caller. The Ghidra name retains the STL family and marks this descriptive element interpretation as a hypothesis.
+
+Capture current header `+04` first. Null begin suppresses the `+08` read. Otherwise compute wrapped32-bit `end-begin`, reinterpret those bits as signed, divide by44 with truncation toward zero, then compare the DWORD index unsigned against the count's bits. Invalid range reaches the genuine BF6713 Source gateway exactly once. Whether validation succeeds or a handler returns, reload CURRENT `+04` and form the modulo32-bit `index*44` address without another check. No proxy, capacity, record, owner, count or global field is read or changed. A returned address is not a guarantee of valid backing.
+
+The caller retains a live DWORD-aligned header through any returning SDK CRT handler. Source uses the already real `invoke_native_invalid_parameter_00bf6713`; it does not call an Original numeric address, throw `range_error`, recover ownership or replace the handler policy. No local cleanup or automatic storage ownership is added.
+
+Native ABI is ECX header, DWORD stack argument, EAX record address, `RET4`. The two-argument C++ API is cdecl. Final strict Win32 `/MD /EHsc /O2 /W4 /WX /fp:strict` compilation passes:59 emitted bytes with one REL32 to the genuine Source gateway. All emitted instructions were read. Equal length does not mean byte identity: the value argument is captured before the first raw read, and current-begin reload precedes the pure multiply in this object; Native loads begin before the stack argument and multiplies before its final memory ADD. No instruction/fault/flag/private CRT ABI equality is claimed. The initial missing direct `<cstddef>` include failure, its command/log and Source revision are retained; the corrected revision compiled without diagnostics.
+
+Project/program-verified proto and forced export identify an existing function. No body/listing creation or repair occurred. The old generic `STL_inst_00acec40` name and previous comments were recorded before the locked rename/comment append, project save and refreshed owned export. The Source gateway inputs are frozen from published8aaf1cbc6. The primary registered the new TU exactly once in Core. Compiled Source `945e81690a56bba069530670aac6dce62159abc9` passed the normal Win32 build and all3/3 existing checks in9.09s. Its actual canonical body is61 bytes with one genuine Source gateway relocation. The final [report](../reports/cc12_native_gui_state_vector_access_153.json) and integration156 record the manifested actual-Core address-only link; no inspected strict/canonical length is a Native byte-identity claim. No new test or reconstructed-function execution has occurred.
